customerOutcome: Select current approved company knowledge without granting access or copying documents into instructions.
entryConditions: Current verified authenticated company membership and native agents:create or target agents:configure authority; instance-admin status does not bypass membership.
Draft belongs to the current creator; editing an existing agent requires current native read and configure authority.
hire_agent_v9 and its effective prerequisites admit new saves; existing reads and content discard survive flag rollback.
exitConditions: Only a canonical accepted draft ID/version permits a saved claim.
Draft saving never changes production agent configuration, grants, runtime or scheduled work.
Testing, effective native policy mapping, publish and active monitoring remain unqualified; no success evidence is manufactured.

content.supportingCopy: Select current approved company knowledge without granting access or copying documents into instructions.
displayedState: Native draft version, section and explicit draft status
Saved-draft blockers are distinct from unsaved local proposals and executed outcomes

inputs.label: knowledgeDocumentIds
inputs.default: Existing saved draft field or safe empty/no-capability default
inputs.help: This is customer data and cannot confer native authority.
inputs.validation: packages/shared/src/agent-authoring.ts strict schema; current native references checked server-side
inputs.autofillOrPrefill: Saved creator-owned native draft; existing agent name/description only, no credentials/effective instruction import

primary.label: Continue
primary.operation: Save the version-fenced typed draft before moving to another section

secondary: Back/section navigation saves the current valid draft
Retry the exact same request after unknown acknowledgement; reload the saved draft explicitly on baseline conflict
destructiveOrIrreversible: Discard draft removes authored content but never pauses/retires the target production agent

canonicalReadDomains: Native agent configuration baseline, current company membership and permissions
Approved native Foundation revisions and existing presence runtime bindings
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: Creator-scoped agent configuration create/save/discard with request hash, row version, database scope/version fences, native audit and post-commit publication
systemWork.authorityEffect: No grants, agent mutation, external messages, runtime provisioning or work execution. Native publication mapping and representative execution are unqualified.
systemWork.asyncWork: Bounded native references and 25-row native timestamp/ID pagination; unknown acknowledgements retain immutable client request bodies/keys.
systemWork.receipt: Current creator-owned canonical draft ID/version; never an inferred active version or first-value receipt.

states.loading: Announce loading only while the current identity/company request is pending.
states.empty: Explain an actual empty authorized result. Missing dependencies or qualified capabilities are separate unavailable states.
states.partial: Retain trustworthy available results and name unavailable dependencies or sources.
states.stale: Remove executable actions and refresh canonical state; preserved input is not evidence of current authority.
states.validation_error: Preserve other entered values, identify the field problem and associate it programmatically with the control.
states.system_error: Explain that the operation is unconfirmed, preserve entered data, and offer a valid retry/refresh or support route.
states.permission_denied: Suppress retained private data and unavailable controls; do not infer additional grants from profile or navigation.
states.recovering: Re-resolve canonical state/version and the original request identity before permitting another effect.
states.success: Announce only the server-confirmed canonical result. First value additionally requires independently verified native artifact/run binding.

navigation.back: Save current valid fields with a fenced command before moving back; browser reload returns to the saved native draft.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: No browser persistent storage for authored content; Save & exit waits for canonical acknowledgement. Discard removes content.
navigation.resume: Read the current creator/company draft version. Permission changes hide retained content before a new native read.

accessibility.initialFocus: Main heading or the dialog category control; keyboard focus is visible and unobscured.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Error summary or first invalid control, with a programmatically associated explanation.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Canonical receipt or next-step heading; announcements do not trap focus.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Native links, labeled inputs, select controls and semantic fieldsets; pending reconciliation disables editing. Standard Tab/Shift+Tab/Enter.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Use status for pending/success and alert for material failures, without repeated routine interruption.
accessibility.targetSize: Custom frequent and primary controls target at least 44 × 44 CSS px.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Require browser/manual verification at 200% and 400% zoom and narrow mobile width; this file is not proof of conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animated transition or moving progress indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: One meaningful H1, persistent visible labels, named sections and logical DOM/focus order.

responsive.wide: Readable constrained content width with natural wrapping.
responsive.narrow: Reflow cards and form actions without concealing utilities or consequences.
responsive.mobile: Touch targets remain reachable; dialogs scroll within the viewport and do not obscure focus.

dataShown: Current creator-owned draft and authorized approved source labels
No credential values, provider endpoints, private chain-of-thought or production instruction import
dataCollected: Explicit bounded structured draft fields and request/version receipts
sensitiveFields: Responsibility, instructions, scenario text, owner and selected source references
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: No draft prose, raw request/error bodies, arbitrary headers, query strings or private IDs in HTTP logs; native audit records fixed actions, versions and section only. Creator-account/tenant/target deletion cascades native draft content.

functional: Verify canonical state, version conflicts, safe replay, unavailable states and principal/company switching on the exact artifact.
accessibility: Verify keyboard/focus/announcements and 200/400% zoom manually on the exact artifact.
securityPrivacy: Verify current membership/resource revocation, tenant isolation, untrusted content and separate private feedback identity purpose.
usability: Use representative exploratory and pre-registered confirmatory journey evidence with explicit PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; source checks are insufficient.
